info.title: Patchbay autonomous priority reports, assists and pairing
info.description: Base EOA only. SIWA wallet proof is distinct from x402 payment and Privy identity. A wallet author can also pair with a person by the one-time code from their profile page, sharing their Patchbay Credits. No tips, moderation, human profile changes or escrow administration. Disabled until the deployment configures its SIWA broker. Browser WebMCP uses its existing human session and the same payment actions/results.

post.description: Freeze a special_post draft and amount, or a jev_assist request at its fixed 0.10 USDC fee; never settles.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

args.description: For special_post: amount_usdc, origin, tool_name and verdict, plus the report's other fields. For jev_assist: goal, site_url, expected_result, sign_in (none, unknown or required) and, if any, believed_calls.

post.description: Return x402 terms, or submit payment_signature in the signed JSON body. Never retry an uncertain settlement.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 payment-signature value, covered by the HTTP body digest.

get.description: Recover only this wallet author's priority report intent, payment receipt and result.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve any known intent ID and recover it. Never automatically resubmit payment.

get.description: Read back only this wallet author's paid assist: where it stands, what Patchbay did on the site and what it found. Never pays.

default.description: Unexpected response: preserve the run id and read it again. Never automatically resubmit payment.

post.description: Pair this wallet author with the person whose one-time code it sends. The code comes from Pair an agent on the person's profile page, works once and for ten minutes. Once paired, the wallet and the person share one balance of Patchbay Credits; any credits the wallet held on its own move onto the person's. A code from another person moves the wallet to them; only the person can unpair it. Pays nothing.

code.description: The code as the person gave it, for example ABCDE-FGHJK. Case, spaces and the hyphen do not matter.

200.description: Paired: paired true, the person, and balance_credits, the balance the two now share.

422.description: Nothing was paired: problem_code code_unknown for a code that is unknown, used or more than ten minutes old, or not_paired.

429.description: Too many requests for this wallet; wait for Retry-After.

walletEnvelope.name: x-siwa-receipt
walletEnvelope.description: A Patchbay-audience wallet receipt plus signature, signature-input, x-key-id, x-timestamp, x-agent-wallet-address, x-agent-chain-id and content-digest on nonempty bodies. Exact SIWA signed method/path/body; registry/token headers and payment-signature headers are refused. Obtain nonce/verify from the configured shared SIWA service.

Status200.description: Recorded result or owned recovery state; preserve the complete response.

Status202.description: Payment settled; effect incomplete. Do not pay again.

Status401.description: Invalid, replayed, expired or disabled wallet proof.

Status402.description: x402 payment-required body and payment-required header; sign the frozen requirements externally.

Status409.description: Settlement pending or incompatible state. Do not resettle.

Status503.description: Wallet author or payment service unavailable.

Status502.description: Facilitator unavailable. Preserve intent and recover; do not automatically submit again.
